title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 7 项，AI × Bio 15 项，AI × Math 5 项，AI Voices 6 项，Engineering 2 项。今日五频道共同日期为 2026-10-12。学术精选以预印本为主，覆盖蛋白设计、生命科学数据与医疗评测、智能体推理和图学习，所列结果尚未等同于同行评议结论。公开观点侧重 LLM 能力认知和基础设施安全，工程侧则出现逆向工程智能体工具与 Python SDK 发布；两者应分别视作观点、项目动向和软件版本信息。

channel_highlights.aivoices: AI Voices 以公开帖文为主：Karpathy 讨论能力认知鸿沟，AgentGarten 发布研究与代码入口，Anthropic 宣布关键基础设施防御计划；均非同行评议结论。

items.title: Filling the Missing Puzzle: Integrating Interaction and Evolutionary Information to Enhance Protein Fitness Prediction in Inverse Folding
items.abstract_or_text: Protein inverse folding, which infers compatible amino acid sequences from a given backbone structure, is central to rational protein design. Current methods rely largely on sequence recovery rate as the evaluation metric, emphasizing structural compatibility but seldom addressing function. Yet functional activity depends on the proper network of non-covalent interactions-protein-ligand contacts being a prime example. We argue that function-oriented protein design is governed by three complementary constraints: structural, interaction, and evolutionary, none of which are handled in a unified manner by existing pretrained models. To bridge this gap, we introduce zPolaron, a graph neural network built on protein-ligand complexes for functional protein design. zPolaron represents residues and ligand atoms as a heterogeneous graph and jointly encodes structural, interaction, and evolutionary information by fusing physical-interaction-enhanced graph representations with ESM-2 embeddings. Across multiple fitness prediction benchmarks, zPolaron outperforms all baselines, with gains evident across structural, interaction, and evolutionary dimensions. Wet-lab experiments further confirm its utility in functional enzyme screening and design: the optimized CalA6-D205A-S160G mutant achieves a 17.84-fold improvement in activity, while the CalB-I121M mutant yields a 1.91-fold increase. Together, these results show that integrating interaction and evolutionary information fills the missing puzzle of inverse folding, enhancing protein fitness prediction beyond structural compatibility. zPolaron is available at https://github.com/zelixirSH/zPolaron.
items.summary_zh: zPolaron 将蛋白—配体相互作用、结构和进化信息整合到异质图神经网络中，用于功能导向的逆折叠与蛋白适应度预测；除多项基准外，作者还以 CalA6-D205A-S160G 和 CalB-I121M 的湿实验验证了活性提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把配体接触显式纳入逆折叠模型，有望让蛋白设计从“序列恢复”更接近功能优化；但活性验证集中于少数突变体，跨蛋白家族和真实设计闭环的泛化仍需独立检验。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质逆折叠从给定的骨架结构推断相容的氨基酸序列，是理性蛋白质设计的核心。现有方法在很大程度上依赖序列恢复率作为评价指标，强调结构相容性，却很少处理功能问题。然而，功能活性依赖于恰当的非共价相互作用网络——蛋白质—配体接触便是一个典型例子。我们认为，功能导向的蛋白质设计受结构、相互作用和进化这三类互补约束支配，而现有预训练模型尚未以统一方式处理它们。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 zPolaron：一种建立在蛋白质—配体复合物之上的、用于功能蛋白设计的图神经网络。zPolaron 将残基和配体原子表示为异质图，并通过融合物理相互作用增强的图表示与 ESM-2 嵌入，联合编码结构、相互作用和进化信息。在多个适应度预测基准上，zPolaron 优于所有基线，在结构、相互作用和进化维度上均显示出提升。湿实验进一步证实了其在功能酶筛选和设计中的效用：优化的 CalA6-D205A-S160G 突变体活性提高了 17.84 倍，而 CalB-I121M 突变体提高了 1.91 倍。总之，这些结果表明，整合相互作用和进化信息填补了逆折叠中的缺失环节，使蛋白质适应度预测超越了结构相容性。zPolaron 已发布于 https://github.com/zelixirSH/zPolaron。

items.title: Autonomous AI agents discover reverse transcriptases with tandem repeat arrays
items.abstract_or_text: Metagenomic databases hold vast quantities of unexplored genetic material that can seed tools for biotechnology and medicine, but discovery is limited by our ability to examine sequence data at scale. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) in an autonomous harness can alleviate this bottleneck and surface novel molecular systems. We deployed Claude Code instances to survey reverse transcriptase (RT) loci across 1.9 billion protein clusters. Among the top candidates were array-associated RTs (ART), a novel family of jumbo-phage RTs coupled with an array of ~200-nucleotide units and a dedicated partner gene. Session transcripts show that Claude identified the ART family by directly examining its DNA sequences and recognizing the atypical repeats, a behavior attributable to specific Mythos 5 internal signals that respond to repeated DNA. ART arrays are highly expressed and appear as discrete units during Staphylococcus phage infection, suggesting an RT system directed by a repertoire of distinct RNAs. These findings indicate that LLMs can autonomously detect anomalies and drive analyses to initiate biological discoveries.
items.summary_zh: 研究以自主运行的 Claude Code 检索 19 亿个蛋白簇中的逆转录酶位点，发现与约 200 nt 重复单元阵列及伙伴基因耦联的 jumbo 噬菌体新型 array-associated RTs（ART）；感染中的表达和离散阵列信号支持其为 RNA 指导系统。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将自主 LLM 工作流用于大规模序列异常发现的具体案例，可能扩展生物技术工具的发现空间；不过 ART 的分子功能仍主要是推断，且模型“自主发现”的因果归因需要可复现的对照审计。
items.abstract_zh: 宏基因组数据库蕴藏着大量尚未探索的遗传物质，可为生物技术和医学工具提供种子；但我们的发现能力受限于大规模审查序列数据的能力。这里，我们表明，处于自主执行框架中的大语言模型（LLMs）可以缓解这一瓶颈并揭示新的分子系统。我们部署 Claude Code 实例，对 19 亿个蛋白簇中的逆转录酶（RT）位点进行了调查。排名靠前的候选物包括阵列相关 RT（ART）：这是一个新的 jumbo 噬菌体 RT 家族，与一个由约 200 个核苷酸单元组成的阵列及一个专属伙伴基因耦联。会话记录显示，Claude 通过直接检查其 DNA 序列并识别非典型重复序列而鉴定出 ART 家族；这种行为可归因于对重复 DNA 作出响应的特异 Mythos 5 内部信号。ART 阵列高表达，并在 Staphylococcus 噬菌体感染期间表现为离散单元，提示这是一种由一组不同 RNA 指导的 RT 系统。这些发现表明，LLMs 能够自主检测异常并推动分析，从而启动生物学发现。

items.title: The Batten disease gene product CLN6 is a glycerophosphoglycerol epimerase that establishes S,S-BMP stereochemistry
items.abstract_or_text: Bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate (BMP), a lysosomal phospholipid essential for lipid catabolism and cholesterol clearance, has a noncanonical S,S glycerol configuration found in no other mammalian phospholipid, a feature necessary for its stability in the lysosome. How cells invert glycerol stereochemistry to build S,S-BMP has remained unexplained since this configuration was discovered five decades ago. Here, we show that the endoplasmic reticulum-resident Batten disease protein CLN6 is a Ca2+-dependent epimerase that isomerizes glycerophosphoglycerol (GPG) from R,S-GPG to S,S-GPG. CLN6-deficient cells, mouse tissues, and patient samples predominantly contain R,S-GPG, S,R-lysophosphatidylglycerol (LPG), and R,S-BMP instead of their S,S counterparts, with a net depletion of BMP. Purified CLN6 catalyzes GPG epimerization in vitro, an activity abolished by a pathogenic substitution in its substrate-binding pocket. Consistently, exogenous S,S-GPG restores BMP synthesis and relieves lipid storage in CLN6-null cells. Our work establishes stereochemical commitment upstream of acylation, placing CLN6, CLN8, and CLN5 in sequence in BMP biosynthesis and unifying the lipid defect across these neurodegenerative disorders.
items.summary_zh: 研究鉴定出 Batten 病蛋白 CLN6 是一种 Ca2+-依赖的 glycerophosphoglycerol epimerase，可将 R,S-GPG 转化为 S,S-GPG，从而在 BMP 生物合成中建立关键立体化学；纯化蛋白、细胞、鼠组织和患者样本均支持该结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作解决了 BMP 非常规 S,S 构型来源这一长期问题，并把 CLN6、CLN8、CLN5 接入同一通路；S,S-GPG 补充的救援结果也提示可干预节点，但离体补充能否转化为疾病治疗尚未得到证明。
items.abstract_zh: 双（单酰基甘油）磷酸（BMP）是一种对脂质分解代谢和胆固醇清除至关重要的溶酶体磷脂，具有其他哺乳动物磷脂中不存在的非经典 S,S 甘油构型；这一特征对于其在溶酶体中的稳定性是必需的。自这种构型在五十年前被发现以来，细胞如何倒转甘油立体化学以构建 S,S-BMP 一直未获解释。这里，我们表明，内质网驻留的 Batten 病蛋白 CLN6 是一种 Ca2+-依赖的 epimerase，可将 glycerophosphoglycerol（GPG）从 R,S-GPG 异构化为 S,S-GPG。CLN6 缺陷细胞、鼠组织和患者样本主要含有 R,S-GPG、S,R-lysophosphatidylglycerol（LPG）和 R,S-BMP，而非其 S,S 对映体，并伴随 BMP 的净耗竭。纯化的 CLN6 能在体外催化 GPG 差向异构化；底物结合口袋中的致病替换会消除该活性。与此一致，外源 S,S-GPG 可恢复 CLN6-null 细胞中的 BMP 合成并缓解脂质贮积。我们的工作在酰化之前确立了立体化学定向步骤，将 CLN6、CLN8 和 CLN5 依次置于 BMP 生物合成中，并统一解释了这些神经退行性疾病中的脂质缺陷。

items.title: Solid-state NMR and first-principle calculations reveal the structure and dynamics of Li-N-H materials
items.abstract_or_text: Lithium-nitrogen-hydrogen (Li-N-H) materials are promising for hydrogen storage, solid-state batteries, and lithium-mediated ammonia synthesis, yet their local structures and proton dynamics remain poorly understood because of compositional disorder and limited sensitivity of conventional diffraction methods. Here, we combine multinuclear solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (1H, 7Li, 14N, and 15N ssNMR) with first-principles calculations to resolve the atomic environments and dynamics of Li3N, LiNH2, and Li1+xNH2-x (. 7Li NMR and density functional theory calculations identify distinct lithium sites in coexisting α- and β-Li3N phases and in tetragonal LiNH2. 1H and 15N NMR, together with 1H-detected 14N spectroscopy, reveal two distinct domains in synthesized lithium-rich Li1+xNH2-x that are not resolved by laboratory X-ray diffraction. Comparison with calculated NMR parameters assigns these domains to LiNH2 and Li2NH, respectively. Variable-temperature 1H-1H exchange spectroscopy shows that correlations between the two domains arise predominantly from spin diffusion rather than interdomain proton exchange, indicating nanoscale structural heterogeneity within a solid solution. Local proton motion occurs within the Li2NH environment and is restricted in the LiNH­2 domains. These results establish a molecular-level relationship between local structure and proton mobility in Li-N-H materials, providing insights relevant to hydrogen storage, solid-state batteries, and ammonia synthesis.
items.summary_zh: 作者将多核固态 NMR 与第一性原理计算结合，解析 Li3N、LiNH2 和锂富 Li1+xNH2-x 的局域结构与质子动力学，识别出 XRD 未分辨的 LiNH2/Li2NH 纳米尺度异质域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这为 Li–N–H 储氢、固态电池和锂介导氨合成材料建立了局域结构—质子迁移之间的实验和计算联系；结论目前集中于所考察的组成与合成样品，尚需检验其在器件工况下的可迁移性。
items.abstract_zh: 锂—氮—氢（Li-N-H）材料有望用于储氢、固态电池和锂介导氨合成；然而，由于组成无序以及常规衍射方法灵敏度有限，其局域结构和质子动力学仍知之甚少。这里，我们结合多核固态核磁共振谱（1H、7Li、14N 和 15N ssNMR）与第一性原理计算，解析 Li3N、LiNH2 和 Li1+xNH2-x 的原子环境和动力学。7Li NMR 和密度泛函理论计算鉴定出共存 α- 和 β-Li3N 相以及四方 LiNH2 中不同的锂位点。1H 和 15N NMR 连同 1H 检测的 14N 光谱，揭示了合成的富锂 Li1+xNH2-x 中两个不同的区域，而实验室 X 射线衍射无法分辨这些区域。与计算的 NMR 参数比较后，将这些区域分别指认为 LiNH2 和 Li2NH。变温 1H-1H 交换光谱显示，两个区域之间的相关性主要源于自旋扩散而非区域间质子交换，表明固溶体内存在纳米尺度结构异质性。局域质子运动发生在 Li2NH 环境中，而在 LiNH2 区域中受到限制。这些结果建立了 Li-N-H 材料中局域结构与质子迁移率之间的分子层面关系，为储氢、固态电池和氨合成提供了相关见解。

items.title: Molecular mechanisms regulating PDE11A4 age-related liquid-liquid phase separation and its reversal by selective PDE11A4-targeted small molecules in cells and brain
items.abstract_or_text: Age-related increases in hippocampal PDE11A expression occur in humans and rodents, causing age-related cognitive decline of social memories. Interestingly, this age-related increase triggers PDE11A4 liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), causing the enzyme to condensate in neurons forming filamentous structures termed "ghost axons". Here we sought to identify molecular mechanisms regulating PDE11A4 LLPS and its reversal by therapeutic agents. PDE11A4 LLPS was increased by broad kinase inhibition and overactivation of the trans-Golgi network (via TGN38 or RhoB) but suppressed by PDE11A4-pS163, PDE11A4-pS239 or a D355A mutation affecting allosteric cGMP-GAF-A interactions. PDE11Ai inhibitors across three scaffolds rapidly reversed PDE11A LLPS independently of their catalytic effects, pS163 or pS239, but rather--at least in part--by reducing PDE11 homodimerization at the GAF-B domain. PDE11Ais blocked exacerbated LLPS caused by age-related PDE11A4 phosphorylation, kinase disruption, and altered proteostasis in hippocampal HT22 neuronal cells. Further, in hippocampus and amygdala of old mice, oral SMQ-03-20 reversed age-related increases in PDE11A4 condensation in ghost axons and protein expression of immunoglobulin light chains (a marker of increased blood-brain permeability), with direct correlation between the two measures. These findings suggest PDE11A4 LLPS is a regulated and druggable mechanism contributing to age-related hippocampal pathology.\
items.summary_zh: 研究解析了 PDE11A4 年龄相关液-液相分离的调控因素，并显示三类 PDE11Ai 可在细胞中迅速逆转凝聚；老年小鼠口服 SMQ-03-20 后，海马和杏仁核的 PDE11A4 凝聚及血脑屏障渗漏相关标志物均下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果将 PDE11A4 凝聚、衰老脑病理与可药靶变构/二聚化联系起来，为靶向蛋白相分离提供机制线索；但行为和长期疗效、安全性及人类转化证据仍不足。
items.abstract_zh: 人类和啮齿动物海马中 PDE11A 表达随年龄增加，导致与年龄相关的社会记忆认知下降。有趣的是，这种年龄相关增加会触发 PDE11A4 液-液相分离（LLPS），使该酶在神经元中凝聚，形成称为“ghost axons”的丝状结构。这里，我们旨在鉴定调控 PDE11A4 LLPS 及其被治疗剂逆转的分子机制。广谱激酶抑制和 trans-Golgi network 过度激活（经由 TGN38 或 RhoB）均增加 PDE11A4 LLPS，而 PDE11A4-pS163、PDE11A4-pS239 或影响变构 cGMP-GAF-A 相互作用的 D355A 突变则抑制其 LLPS。三种骨架的 PDE11Ai 抑制剂均能快速逆转 PDE11A LLPS，且不依赖于其催化效应、pS163 或 pS239；相反，至少部分是通过减少 GAF-B 域处的 PDE11 同二聚化实现。PDE11Ai 阻断了由年龄相关 PDE11A4 磷酸化、激酶扰动以及海马 HT22 神经元细胞中蛋白稳态改变所加剧的 LLPS。此外，在老年小鼠的海马和杏仁核中，口服 SMQ-03-20 逆转了 PDE11A4 在 ghost axons 中凝聚的年龄相关增加，以及免疫球蛋白轻链蛋白表达的增加（后者是血脑屏障通透性增加的标志）；这两项指标直接相关。这些发现提示，PDE11A4 LLPS 是一种受调控且可药靶的机制，可促成与年龄相关的海马病理。

items.title: SCKAnalyzer: A Web Tool for Single-Cycle Kinetics Analysis and Simulation
items.abstract_or_text: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) and biolayer interferometry (BLI) are well-established label-free analytical technologies used to determine biomolecular interaction rates (ka, kd) and equilibrium constants (KD). While assays historically rely on multi-cycle kinetics (MCK), this approach requires intermediate surface regeneration, risking sensor degradation and increasing reagent consumption. Single-cycle kinetics (SCK) avoids regeneration by sequentially injecting increasing analyte concentrations. However, implementing SCK workflows on biosensor platforms like the OctetRR8 BLI instrument (Sartorius) remains a challenge due to the lack of built-in or online data analysis tools. To address this, we introduce SCKAnalyzer, a free, user-friendly web application designed for processing and fitting SCK datasets. SCKAnalyzer accepts column-based text files and native raw BLI data (.frd format) from Sartorius instruments, performing data pre-processing and non-linear fitting to a 1:1 interaction model. Additionally, it offers advanced simulation capabilities that allow variable association and dissociation durations across sequential injection steps, a feature absent in existing platforms such as BiacoreTMSimul8. The performance of SCKAnalyzer was experimentally validated using a 3-step SCK method (SCK3) for DNA/RNA duplex formation on a Biacore T200, as well as 4-step (SCK4) and 5-step (SCK5) methods for DNA/DNA duplex formation on an OctetRR8 BLI instrument. Binding parameters (ka, kd, KD) derived from SCKAnalyzer showed excellent agreement with values from established proprietary softwares such as Biacore T200 Evaluation Software v3.2.1 and BIAevaluation v4.1.1. SCKAnalyzer provides a practical alternative to MCK, reducing probe consumption and extending SCK utility across biosensor platforms. SCKAnalyzer is available at sck.iecb.u-bordeaux.fr (source code: github.com/synthaze/sckanalyzer).
items.summary_zh: SCKAnalyzer 是处理单循环动力学 SPR/BLI 数据的免费网页工具，支持原始 .frd 文件、1:1 非线性拟合及可变注射时程模拟；在 DNA/RNA 与 DNA/DNA 双链形成实验中，其 ka、kd、KD 与商用软件高度一致。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具降低了不经表面再生获取结合动力学参数的实验与分析门槛，适用于生物分子和药物结合研究；当前验证以 1:1 模型和核酸双链体系为主，复杂多价结合体系仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 表面等离子体共振（SPR）和生物层干涉（BLI）是成熟的无标记分析技术，用于测定生物分子相互作用速率（ka、kd）和平衡常数（KD）。虽然历史上测定通常依赖多循环动力学（MCK），但这种方法需要中间表面再生，可能造成传感器降解并增加试剂消耗。单循环动力学（SCK）通过顺序注入递增浓度的分析物来避免再生。然而，由于缺乏内置或在线数据分析工具，在诸如 OctetRR8 BLI instrument（Sartorius）等生物传感器平台上实施 SCK 工作流仍具挑战。为解决这一问题，我们推出 SCKAnalyzer：一款免费、用户友好的网页应用，用于处理和拟合 SCK 数据集。SCKAnalyzer 接受列式文本文件和 Sartorius 仪器的原生原始 BLI 数据（.frd format），执行数据预处理并拟合到 1:1 相互作用模型。此外，它还提供高级模拟功能，可在顺序注射步骤中改变缔合和解离时长；这是现有平台如 BiacoreTMSimul8 所不具备的特性。SCKAnalyzer 的性能通过在 Biacore T200 上进行 DNA/RNA 双链形成的三步 SCK 方法（SCK3），以及在 OctetRR8 BLI 上进行 DNA/DNA 双链形成的四步（SCK4）和五步（SCK5）方法得到实验验证。SCKAnalyzer 得出的结合参数（ka、kd、KD）与成熟专有软件如 Biacore T200 Evaluation Software v3.2.1 和 BIAevaluation v4.1.1 的数值高度一致。SCKAnalyzer 为 MCK 提供了实用替代方案，可减少探针消耗，并扩展 SCK 在不同生物传感器平台上的效用。SCKAnalyzer 可在 sck.iecb.u-bordeaux.fr 获得（源代码：github.com/synthaze/sckanalyzer）。
items.author_line: Malard, F., Blanc, J.-M., Roubin, E., Schafer, T., Di Primo, C.

items.title: Machine learning classifies subcellular Golgi morphology from imaging flow cytometry during inflammatory activation: an exploratory study
items.abstract_or_text: Inflammatory activation remodels the Golgi apparatus to meet increased secretory demand, yet whether these structural changes carry computationally accessible information about immune cell state has not been explored. Here we show that machine learning applied to imaging flow cytometry images of the Golgi can distinguish lipopolysaccharide (LPS) treated from control cells. We trained models on Golgi images from human THP-1 monocytes before and 16 h after LPS stimulation in vitro, and from circulating myeloid cells of mice 24 h after intratracheal LPS or saline in vivo. In each dataset, the best-performing model was a deep learning model trained directly on images rather than a classifier using predefined morphometric features. Cross-domain performance varied with the model, transfer direction and use of labelled target data: several deep learning models trained on mouse images classified THP-1 cells above chance without changing model parameters. Grad-CAM highlighted regions within or adjacent to the GM130 fluorescence pattern. These findings indicate that GM130 images carry information associated with LPS treatment that supports classification within and across the two datasets. To our knowledge, this is the first application of supervised deep learning to imaging flow cytometry images of a subcellular organelle for inflammatory phenotyping, establishing organelle level image analysis as a potential complement to molecular assays for immune cell classification.
items.summary_zh: 该探索性研究用深度学习分析成像流式细胞术中的 GM130 Golgi 图像，以区分 LPS 处理与对照的 THP-1 单核细胞和小鼠髓系细胞；图像端到端模型优于预定义形态特征模型，部分小鼠训练模型可零参数迁移至 THP-1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作表明细胞器形态可提供可计算的炎症表型信号，为分子检测提供补充；但研究规模和任务范围有限，跨物种迁移表现依赖模型与方向，不能据此推断形态变化的机制或临床可用性。
items.abstract_zh: 炎症激活会重塑 Golgi apparatus，以满足增加的分泌需求；然而，这些结构变化是否携带可由计算访问的免疫细胞状态信息尚未被探索。这里，我们表明，应用于 Golgi 成像流式细胞术图像的机器学习能够区分 lipopolysaccharide（LPS）处理细胞与对照细胞。我们在体外 LPS 刺激前和刺激后 16 h 的人 THP-1 monocytes 的 Golgi 图像上，以及在气管内给予 LPS 或 saline 后 24 h 的小鼠循环髓系细胞图像上训练模型。在每个数据集中，最佳模型都是直接用图像训练的深度学习模型，而非使用预定义形态学特征的分类器。跨域性能因模型、迁移方向和是否使用带标签的目标数据而异：若干在小鼠图像上训练的深度学习模型，在不改变模型参数的情况下，能够以高于随机水平的表现对 THP-1 细胞进行分类。Grad-CAM 突出了 GM130 荧光图样内部或邻近的区域。这些发现表明，GM130 图像携带与 LPS 处理相关的信息，支持在两个数据集内部及跨数据集进行分类。据我们所知，这是首次将监督式深度学习应用于亚细胞细胞器的成像流式细胞术图像以进行炎症表型分析，它确立了细胞器层面图像分析作为免疫细胞分类中分子测定潜在补充方法的地位。
items.author_line: Zhang, X., Fang, M., Geng, B., Che, P.

items.title: DBCLS BioHackathon 2026 report: An interactive, harmonised BioSample metadata resource for biological sample discovery
items.abstract_or_text: The BioSample database contains tens of millions of records describing biological samples, but their metadata are submitted largely as key--value pairs with inconsistent field names, terminology and free-text descriptions, limiting search and reuse. Before the DBCLS BioHackathon 2026, we used a pipeline based on locally hosted large language models (LLMs) to extract nine types of biological information (cell line, cell type, tissue, disease, drug, knockout gene, knockdown gene, overexpressed gene and ChIP antigen) from 4.2 million human and mouse BioSample records and map them to ontology terms, producing a harmonised collection of 8.2 million extracted values. During the BioHackathon, we extended this work in three directions. First, we developed an alpha version of a web application for searching this collection by ontology terms and visualising the experimental conditions of selected samples. Second, we developed a provenance-tracing procedure, combining deterministic matching with LLM-based checks, that linked 99% of extracted values to supporting text in the original records. The resulting provenance links showed that although 32 submitted field names accounted for 90% of the evidence, the remaining 10% was spread across more than 6,000 other field names. Third, we developed a procedure in which an LLM assesses mapping correctness and classifies the causes of errors, offering a scalable alternative to building new manually curated gold standards. Our preliminary results show the potential of locally hosted LLMs to harmonise existing BioSample metadata at scale. Future work will validate the LLM-based evaluations with human experts and extend the approach to additional species.
items.summary_zh: 本地部署LLM将420万条人和小鼠BioSample记录标准化为820万条可追溯的本体注释值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为样本元数据的检索、复用和审计提供了大规模基础设施，但LLM评估仍有待人工专家验证。
items.abstract_zh: BioSample数据库包含数千万条描述生物样本的记录，但其元数据大多以键值对形式提交，字段名、术语和自由文本描述并不一致，限制了检索和复用。在DBCLS BioHackathon 2026之前，我们使用基于本地部署大语言模型（LLM）的流程，从420万条人类和小鼠BioSample记录中提取九类生物学信息（细胞系、细胞类型、组织、疾病、药物、敲除基因、敲低基因、过表达基因和ChIP抗原），并将其映射到本体术语，生成了包含820万条提取值的标准化集合。在BioHackathon期间，我们从三个方向扩展了这项工作。第一，我们开发了一个网络应用的alpha版本，可按本体术语检索该集合，并可视化所选样本的实验条件。第二，我们开发了一个溯源追踪程序，将确定性匹配与基于LLM的检查相结合，把99%的提取值关联至原始记录中的支持性文本。所得溯源链接表明，尽管32个提交字段名贡献了90%的证据，其余10%分散在6,000多个其他字段名中。第三，我们开发了一项程序，由LLM评估映射正确性并分类错误原因，为建立新的人工整理金标准提供可扩展替代方案。我们的初步结果显示，本地部署LLM具有大规模标准化既有BioSample元数据的潜力。未来工作将以人类专家验证基于LLM的评估，并将该方法扩展到更多物种。
items.author_line: Ikeda S, Fàbrega N, Suetake H, Ohta T

items.title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages. MedBenchAgent separates planning, which derives and verifies the specification, from instantiation, which constructs and audits items under the locked specification. MedBenchAgent achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9%, outperforming direct task induction (79.2-80.0%) and prior-guided induction (85.1%); 994 of 1,000 sampled items from correctly identified tasks pass human audit. We further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain and evaluate twelve VLMs, revealing task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores. These results establish constrained compilation as a scalable and auditable framework for medical VLM benchmark construction beyond question generation.
items.summary_zh: MedBenchAgent以受约束编译和中间表示自动构建可审计的医疗VLM基准规范与测试条目。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把医疗基准构建从题目生成扩展为任务、证据和协议的可追溯编译流程，并进行了人工抽样审计。
items.abstract_zh: 凭借标注丰富的影像数据集和大语言模型（LLM），大规模构建医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）基准日益可行；但现有自动化主要聚焦于在预先定义的基准规范内生成评估条目。我们研究一个更广泛的问题：如何自动推导规范本身，即评估什么、哪些标注支持各项任务，以及如何将这些证据转化为可靠的评估条目。我们将基准构建表述为受约束编译，其中基准规范由评估要求、异质标注和医学知识逐步推导而来。基于这一表述，我们提出MedBenchAgent，一个多智能体框架，采用基准中间表示（BIR）在各构建阶段编码任务定义、证据映射、评估协议和条目规范。MedBenchAgent将从规范推导和验证的规划阶段，与在锁定规范下构建和审计条目的实例化阶段分开。MedBenchAgent的任务空间F1达到90.9%，优于直接任务归纳（79.2–80.0%）和先验引导归纳（85.1%）；从正确识别任务中抽取的1,000个条目中，有994个通过人工审计。我们还展示了其向一个专科医疗领域的可迁移性，并评估12个VLM，发现了汇总分数所掩盖的任务和场景特异性差异。这些结果将受约束编译确立为一种可扩展、可审计的医疗VLM基准构建框架，超越了单纯的问题生成。
items.author_line: Yulin Fu, Junren Wang, Guangjing Yang, Zhangyuan Yu, Wanran Sun, Jiabao Zhou, Jin Yin, Qicheng Lao

items.title: A unified framework for quantitative splicing and transcript prediction
items.abstract_or_text: RNA splicing is frequently disrupted by genetic variation, contributing to a wide range of human diseases. Identifying the variants responsible for altered splicing is therefore crucial but has long been challenging. Deep learning models that predict splicing from genomic sequence have substantially advanced their detection, but accurately resolving their quantitative effects on splicing and the resulting transcripts remains an unmet need. Here we introduce SpliceAI2, a deep learning model trained end-to-end on splice site, splice junction, and transcript usage across multiple mammalian species. SpliceAI2 reconstructs complete transcripts directly from genomic sequence and considerably improves identification of splice-altering variants and quantification of their effects in diverse benchmarks spanning cryptic splicing, splicing quantitative trait loci, and massively parallel reporter assays. Human population datasets provide independent validation of these predicted functional effects through evidence of natural selection and associated changes in plasma protein abundance. Application to a rare disease cohort reveals that predicted splice-altering variants are highly enriched in disease-associated genes and account for 15% of the excess genetic burden, with approximately half residing in deep intronic regions likely missed by exome sequencing. Together, these findings establish SpliceAI2 as a major step forward in interpreting splice-altering variants across the human genome.
items.summary_zh: SpliceAI2从基因组序列重建完整转录本，并定量预测变异对剪接的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨基准、群体遗传和罕见病队列的证据，使其成为解释深内含子剪接变异的有价值候选工具。
items.abstract_zh: RNA剪接常受遗传变异扰动，并促成多种人类疾病。因此，识别导致剪接改变的变异至关重要，但长期以来一直具有挑战性。根据基因组序列预测剪接的深度学习模型已大幅推进此类变异的检测，但准确解析其对剪接及所产生转录本的定量影响仍未得到满足。在此，我们介绍SpliceAI2：一个端到端训练的深度学习模型，覆盖多个哺乳动物物种的剪接位点、剪接连接和转录本使用。SpliceAI2直接从基因组序列重建完整转录本，并在涵盖隐匿剪接、剪接数量性状位点和大规模并行报告实验的多种基准中，显著提升了剪接改变变异的识别及其效应的定量。人类群体数据通过自然选择证据和血浆蛋白丰度的相关变化，独立验证了这些预测的功能效应。对一个罕见病队列的应用显示，预测的剪接改变变异在疾病相关基因中高度富集，并占额外遗传负担的15%；其中约一半位于外显子组测序可能遗漏的深内含子区域。总体而言，这些发现将SpliceAI2确立为解释全人类基因组剪接改变变异的重要进展。
items.author_line: Jaganathan, K., Chen, J., Liu, X., Zhang, Y., Kim, Y., Banerjee, A., Fiziev, P. P., Wilcox, N., Taskiran, I. I., Cai, Y., Wigdor, E. M., Chew, G.-L., Png, G., McRae, J. F., Reddy, A. J., Chao, K.-H., Mehio, R., Sanders, S. J., Farh, K. K.-H.

items.title: DeSPA uncovers genes with cross-state spatial pattern remodeling and coordinated spatial programs across multi-slice spatial transcriptomics atlases
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics increasingly generates multi-slice atlases spanning developmental, regenerative, and disease-associated states. Identifying genes with spatial pattern remodeling across these states is essential for understanding tissue reorganization and the underlying gene programs, yet few existing methods systematically detect such changes while accounting for variation among replicate slices. Here we introduce DeSPA, a statistical framework that models gene-specific spatial variation within each slice using a linear mixed model, tests for cross-state remodeling by aggregating evidence across replicate slices, and organizes identified genes into interpretable spatial co-expression modules that reveal coordinated spatial programs. Simulations show that DeSPA achieves high power while controlling the false discovery rate under inter-slice heterogeneity. In mouse embryogenesis, it recovers programs linked to extracellular matrix organization, muscle formation, neural development, and erythrocyte development. In diabetic testis, it reveals disruption of a late-spermatid spatial program consistent with known spermatogenic dysfunction, while maintaining stable gene rankings under coordinate rotation. In axolotl brain, regeneration preserves a developmental-like biosynthetic backbone but reorganizes it into regeneration-specific modules. Across two mouse intracerebral hemorrhage models, DeSPA resolves a conserved spatial injury program alongside model-specific synaptic and tissue-response programs. Together, these findings establish DeSPA as a scalable and interpretable framework for detecting spatial pattern remodeling and resolving coordinated spatial programs across diverse biological states.
items.summary_zh: DeSPA以线性混合模型整合多切片空间转录组，识别跨状态重塑的空间基因程序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法同时处理切片间异质性和假发现率，并在发育、再生、糖尿病及脑出血模型中展示了可解释结果。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学日益产生跨越发育、再生和疾病相关状态的多切片图谱。识别这些状态间空间模式发生重塑的基因，对于理解组织重组及其背后的基因程序至关重要；然而，现有方法很少能在考虑重复切片间变异的同时系统检测这些变化。在此，我们介绍DeSPA，一个统计框架：它用线性混合模型对每张切片内基因特异性空间变异进行建模，通过聚合重复切片间的证据检验跨状态重塑，并将识别出的基因组织成可解释的空间共表达模块，以揭示协调的空间程序。模拟表明，DeSPA在切片间异质性条件下能够控制假发现率，同时具有高检验效能。在小鼠胚胎发生中，它恢复了与细胞外基质组织、肌肉形成、神经发育和红细胞发育相关的程序。在糖尿病睾丸中，它揭示了与已知精子发生功能障碍一致的晚期精子细胞空间程序紊乱，同时在坐标旋转下维持稳定的基因排序。在美西螈脑中，再生保留了发育样的生物合成骨架，但将其重组为再生特异性模块。跨两个小鼠脑内出血模型，DeSPA解析出一个保守的空间损伤程序，以及模型特异的突触和组织反应程序。总体而言，这些发现将DeSPA确立为一个可扩展且可解释的框架，用于检测空间模式重塑，并解析多种生物状态下协调的空间程序。
items.author_line: Wen, H., Shen, Q., Yuan, Z., Zhang, S.

items.title: Mapping polygenic risk scores to brain cells: insights for neurodegenerative diseases
items.abstract_or_text: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) are driven by multiple related yet distinct pathological processes that evolve over decades, resulting in substantial clinical and neuropathological heterogeneity. Postmortem examinations of older individuals frequently reveal multiple coexisting neuropathologies, however, the underlying pathological processes cannot be easily assessed directly in living individuals. To quantify pathology-specific genetic signatures, we analysed a spectrum of NDDs using polygenic risk scores (PRSs) in the UK Biobank, restricting analyses to genes reported to be expressed in major brain cell-types, including microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, and neurons. We found substantial overlap among purportedly cell-type specific gene sets (21-29%), with APOE or neighbouring genes from the APOE locus represented in all gene sets, indicating that current cell-type specific annotations capture considerable shared genetic variation across cell-types. Jointly, cell-type specific PRSs explained a large proportion (60-93%) of the genetic liability for NDDs in which dementia is a major clinical manifestation. Alzheimer's disease (AD) showed associations across all cell-types, with oligodendrocyte- and astrocyte-based PRSs demonstrating strong effects independent of APOE. AD PRS and APOE status independently differentiated Parkinson's disease (PD) with dementia from PD without dementia. PD without dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) exhibited distinct genetic profiles, with limited overlap with other NDDs. Collectively, these findings reveal both shared and disease-specific genetic contributions across neurodegenerative disorders and demonstrate that currently available cell-type specific gene sets capture substantial overlapping genetic risk. The imperfect alignment between clinical phenotypes and underlying pathology, coupled with the extensive overlap of gene expression across these cell types, underscores the persistent challenges in resolving the genetic architecture of neurodegenerative diseases and elucidating their underlying biological mechanisms.
items.summary_zh: 基于UK Biobank的细胞类型限制性PRS分析刻画了神经退行性疾病共享与特异的遗传风险。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果强调现有细胞类型基因集及APOE位点带来的重叠，提示将PRS直接归因于单一脑细胞类型应保持谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 神经退行性疾病（NDD）由多种彼此相关但又不同的病理过程驱动，这些过程历经数十年演变，导致显著的临床和神经病理异质性。对老年人的尸检常发现多种共存的神经病理，但其背后的病理过程无法在活体个体中直接轻易评估。为量化病理特异的遗传特征，我们在UK Biobank中使用多基因风险评分（PRS）分析了一系列NDD，并将分析限制于据报道在主要脑细胞类型中表达的基因，包括小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞和神经元。我们发现，所谓细胞类型特异基因集之间存在大量重叠（21–29%），且APOE或APOE位点邻近基因在所有基因集中均有代表性，表明当前细胞类型特异注释捕获了跨细胞类型的大量共享遗传变异。合并来看，细胞类型特异PRS解释了以痴呆为主要临床表现的NDD中遗传易感性的很大比例（60–93%）。Alzheimer's disease（AD）在所有细胞类型中均显示关联，少突胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞PRS表现出独立于APOE的强效应。AD PRS和APOE状态可独立区分伴痴呆的Parkinson's disease（PD）与不伴痴呆的PD。不伴痴呆的PD和amyotrophic lateral sclerosis（ALS）表现出不同的遗传特征，与其他NDD的重叠有限。总体而言，这些发现揭示了神经退行性疾病之间共享和疾病特异的遗传贡献，并表明当前可用的细胞类型特异基因集捕获了大量重叠的遗传风险。临床表型与潜在病理之间并不完全对应，加之这些细胞类型间基因表达存在广泛重叠，凸显了解析遗传架构和阐明其潜在生物学机制所持续面临的挑战。
items.author_line: Simmonds, E., McKeever, A., Yaman, U., Leonenko, G., Kimatova, K., Taylor, P., Chandran, S., Ryten, M., Khakh, B., O'Brien, J. T., Spires-Jones, T., Salih, D. A., Escott-Price, V.

items.title: Label-free identification of bacterial species using adapted vision transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Antibiotic resistance is an increasingly serious problem worldwide. Identifying the bacterial species can help guide antibiotic selection and improve patient outcomes. In sepsis, where every minute counts, rapid identification is particularly important, and new approaches are needed. In this study, deep learning models were trained to identify bacterial species from phase-contrast time-lapse images of cells growing in microfluidic traps, without fluorescent labels. We demonstrated this approach in two previous studies using laboratory strains. Here, the previous work is extended to clinical bacterial isolates, evaluating performance on isolates not seen during training. Furthermore, it was tested whether autofluorescence could aid species identification. Two validation sets were acquired in separate experiments from the training data, the first containing clinical-isolate traps with five species (Escherichia coli, Enterococcus faecalis, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus and Enterobacter cloacae), imaged every two minutes, and the second containing clinical isolates of two species (E. coli and K. pneumoniae) recovered from spiked donor blood, imaged every minute. Training with the best previous CNN method achieved unsatisfactory results. Therefore, vision transformers were explored, and a self-supervised adaptation procedure was developed for pretrained DINOv3 using a frozen teacher, followed by supervised classification using time-lapse montages. Mean macro-F1 was 93.6 {+/-} 1.3% for isolates precultured in Mueller-Hinton medium using 60 frames (118 minutes) and 87.2 {+/-} 2.7% for isolates precultured in blood using 55 frames (54 minutes) (mean {+/-} sample standard deviation across training seeds). Performance was evaluated over time by increasing the number of frames available to the model during testing, and Fourier-domain filtering approximated reduced numerical aperture. The results are promising and suggest that the aperture can be decreased while retaining good results. However, further evaluation on independent isolates, experiments and patient samples is needed to establish generalization. Together with previous findings, these results bring us closer to rapid image-based diagnostics that could transform the initial treatment of acute bacterial infections by enabling better-informed antibiotic selection.
items.summary_zh: 适配后的DINOv3视觉Transformer可由无标记相差延时图像识别临床分离菌种。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 独立实验验证集取得较高宏平均F1，具备快速感染诊断潜力，但作者明确指出仍需患者样本和更广泛独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性是全球日益严重的问题。识别细菌物种有助于指导抗生素选择并改善患者结局。在每一分钟都至关重要的脓毒症中，快速鉴定尤其重要，因此需要新方法。本研究训练深度学习模型，利用生长于微流控捕获阱中细胞的相差延时图像、而非荧光标记来识别细菌物种。我们此前两项研究已在实验室菌株上展示此方法。本研究将既往工作扩展至临床细菌分离株，评估其在训练中未见分离株上的表现。此外，还测试了自发荧光能否辅助物种鉴定。两个验证集在与训练数据分开的实验中采集：第一个包含5个物种的临床分离株捕获阱（Escherichia coli、Enterococcus faecalis、Klebsiella pneumoniae、Staphylococcus aureus和Enterobacter cloacae），每两分钟成像一次；第二个包含从加标供体血液中回收的两种临床分离株（E. coli和K. pneumoniae），每分钟成像一次。使用此前最佳CNN方法训练得到的结果并不令人满意。因此，我们探索了视觉Transformer，并为预训练DINOv3开发了一种自监督适配流程：使用冻结的教师模型，随后利用延时拼图进行监督分类。对在Mueller-Hinton培养基中预培养的分离株，使用60帧（118分钟）时，平均宏F1为93.6 ± 1.3%；对在血液中预培养的分离株，使用55帧（54分钟）时，平均宏F1为87.2 ± 2.7%（均为训练随机种子间的均值 ± 样本标准差）。通过在测试时逐步增加模型可用帧数来评估随时间的性能，并以傅里叶域滤波近似降低数值孔径。结果令人鼓舞，提示在保持良好结果的同时可以降低孔径。然而，仍需在独立分离株、独立实验和患者样本上进一步评估，才能确立其泛化性。结合既往发现，这些结果使我们更接近于快速图像诊断；该诊断可通过支持更充分的信息化抗生素选择，改变急性细菌感染的初始治疗。

items.title: The essential lipoprotein maturation enzyme Lgt is required for flagellar and membrane integrity in Helicobacter pylori
items.abstract_or_text: Pre-prolipoprotein phosphatidylglycerol diacylglyceryl transferase (Lgt) catalyzes the first step in the lipoprotein modification pathway and is essential for growth and viability of Helicobacter pylori. We explored the fate of H. pylori cells under Lgt depletion conditions to obtain insight into Lgt function on morphology and physiology. Downregulation of lgt expression led to growth arrest and a heterogenous population of small rod-shaped cells and small round cells with spiky protrusions, a loose outer membrane and disintegrated flagella. H. pylori overcomes a defect in lipoprotein modification through alteration of its gene expression profile resulting in so-called revertants. Outer membrane protein synthesis, carbon metabolism and nutrient uptake was reduced, and protein translation and flagellar biogenesis increased. Lgt specific regulation was observed in phospholipid biosynthesis resulting in an initial increase in cardiolipin followed by an increase in lysophospholipids at the time of adaptation. Suppressors of {Delta}lgt that were selected on solid media under restrictive conditions either lacked chromosomal mutations or had mutations in the cagUT-tetR regulon controlling the expression of lgt. A suppressor without mutations had an altered expression profile that led to downregulation of a DNA methyltransferase and upregulation of HP_0014, a motility associated glycosyltransferase family protein. Transmission electron microscopy and single cell video microscopy showed that a subpopulation of cells is motile in the revertant while the suppressor regained full motility with higher average speed compared to the wild type strain. Overall, our data show that lipoprotein modification by Lgt is important for membrane and flagellar integrity and that the heterogenous character of H. pylori cultures allows individual cells to overcome this cell envelope stress and survive. Our findings are important for antibacterial development strategies targeting essential integral membrane enzymes involved in lipoprotein modification and stimulate exploration of synergetic activity between known antibiotics and novel antibacterial agents targeting novel cellular pathways.
items.summary_zh: Lgt耗竭显示其对Helicobacter pylori膜和鞭毛完整性不可或缺，并揭示了适应性逃逸机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多组学、电子显微和单细胞运动成像共同支持Lgt作为抗菌药物开发候选靶点，但尚未证明治疗效应。
items.abstract_zh: 前脂蛋白磷脂酰甘油二酰基甘油基转移酶（Lgt）催化脂蛋白修饰途径的第一步，对Helicobacter pylori的生长和存活必不可少。我们探索了Lgt耗竭条件下H. pylori细胞的命运，以深入了解Lgt在形态和生理中的功能。下调lgt表达导致生长停滞，并形成由小杆状细胞和带尖刺突起的小圆形细胞组成的异质群体；这些细胞外膜疏松，鞭毛解体。H. pylori可通过改变其基因表达谱来克服脂蛋白修饰缺陷，从而形成所谓回复体。外膜蛋白合成、碳代谢和营养摄取降低，而蛋白质翻译和鞭毛生物发生增加。观察到Lgt特异调控磷脂生物合成：先是心磷脂增加，随后在适应时出现溶血磷脂增加。在限制条件下于固体培养基中筛选的Δlgt抑制子，要么缺乏染色体突变，要么在控制lgt表达的cagUT-tetR调控子中携带突变。一个无突变抑制子具有改变的表达谱，导致DNA甲基转移酶下调，以及HP_0014（一种运动相关糖基转移酶家族蛋白）上调。透射电子显微镜和单细胞视频显微镜显示，回复体中一个细胞亚群具有运动性，而抑制子恢复了完全运动性，其平均速度高于野生型菌株。总体而言，我们的数据表明，Lgt介导的脂蛋白修饰对膜和鞭毛完整性至关重要，且H. pylori培养物的异质性使个别细胞能够克服这种细胞包膜应激并存活。我们的发现对靶向参与脂蛋白修饰的必需整合膜酶的抗菌开发策略具有重要意义，并推动探索已知抗生素与靶向新细胞通路的新型抗菌剂之间的协同活性。

items.title: AI-Enabled Echocardiography Identifies Prominent Epicardial Adipose Tissue Associated With an Adverse Cardiometabolic Profile
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Excess epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) is associated with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) dysfunction, but its assessment has traditionally required advanced imaging. Objectives: We investigated whether AI-enabled echocardiography could characterize epicardial adiposity and identify residual cardiometabolic risk beyond body mass index (BMI). Methods: We developed PanAdipo, a video-based deep learning model in 1,114,441 videos from 28,797 studies across the Yale-New Haven Health System (YNHHS; 2016-2022), using report-derived expert reader labels of prominent EAT (2.3% of studies). PanAdipo was evaluated in five cohorts: a temporally distinct YNHHS transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) set (n=4,588 patients contributing 5,130 studies), an emergency department point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) cohort (n=10,957), the geographically distinct MIMIC-IV dataset (n=4,549), the community-based Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA Exam 6, n=2,740), and in held-out YNHHS patients with paired coronary CT angiography within 12 months (n=5,167). Analyses examined discrimination of the report label and of CT-defined high indexed EAT volume, correlation with paired cardiac CT phenotypes, and BMI-adjusted associations with cardiometabolic biomarkers and newly documented metabolic disease. Results: In the held-out health system test set, PanAdipo identified prominent EAT documented in clinical reports with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.86 (95% CI, 0.82-0.91) across all views and of up to 0.93 when combining apical 4-chamber and parasternal views. Against paired CT-derived measurements, PanAdipo discriminated age- and sex-specific high EAT (EAT/heart volume [≥]95th percentile) with AUROCs of 0.91 to 0.95 across age-sex groups and correlated more strongly with indexed EAT volume ({rho}=0.76) than with BMI ({rho}=0.41, all P<0.001); PanAdipo alone explained 53% of indexed EAT volume variance, versus 23% for age, sex, and BMI combined. In MESA, higher scores were associated with an adverse metabolic profile (higher HOMA-IR [{beta}=0.17 per SD; 95% CI, 0.11-0.22]) after adjustment for age, sex, and BMI. In health system TTE and POCUS cohorts, higher scores were associated with newly documented MASLD/MASH (BMI-adjusted pooled HR 1.31 [1.03-1.67] per SD of log[PanAdipo]) and hyperlipidemia (1.11 [1.04-1.18]). Conclusions: AI-enabled echocardiography provides a scalable digital biomarker that characterizes prominent epicardial adiposity and is associated with an adverse cardiometabolic profile, highlighting a role for echocardiography in metabolic risk stratification.
items.summary_zh: PanAdipo从超声心动图视频估计显著心外膜脂肪，并在多个队列中与CT指标和心代谢风险相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究具有百万级视频训练规模和多队列外部评估；其风险结果为关联，尚不等于临床结局改善。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：过多心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）与心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）功能障碍相关，但其评估传统上需要先进影像。目的：我们研究AI赋能的超声心动图能否表征心外膜脂肪，并识别体重指数（BMI）以外的残余心代谢风险。方法：我们在Yale-New Haven Health System（YNHHS；2016–2022）的28,797项检查、1,114,441段视频中开发了基于视频的深度学习模型PanAdipo，使用报告中提取的专家阅片者标注的显著EAT（占检查的2.3%）。在五个队列中评估PanAdipo：时间上不同的YNHHS经胸超声心动图（TTE）集（n=4,588名患者，贡献5,130项检查）、急诊科床旁超声（POCUS）队列（n=10,957）、地理上不同的MIMIC-IV数据集（n=4,549）、基于社区的Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis（MESA第6次检查，n=2,740），以及YNHHS中12个月内有配对冠状动脉CT血管造影的留出患者（n=5,167）。分析检验了对报告标记和CT定义的高指数化EAT体积的区分能力、与配对心脏CT表型的相关性，以及在调整BMI后与心代谢生物标志物和新近记录代谢疾病的关联。结果：在留出的卫生系统测试集中，PanAdipo对临床报告记录的显著EAT的识别，在全部视图中受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.86（95% CI，0.82–0.91）；结合心尖四腔和胸骨旁视图时最高达0.93。相对于配对CT测量，PanAdipo在各年龄-性别组对高EAT（EAT/心脏体积≥第95百分位）的区分AUROC为0.91至0.95，并且与指数化EAT体积的相关性（ρ=0.76）强于与BMI的相关性（ρ=0.41，均P<0.001）；PanAdipo单独解释了指数化EAT体积方差的53%，而年龄、性别和BMI合计仅解释23%。在MESA中，经年龄、性别和BMI调整后，较高分数与不良代谢特征相关（HOMA-IR更高：每SD β=0.17；95% CI，0.11–0.22）。在卫生系统TTE和POCUS队列中，较高分数与新近记录的MASLD/MASH（调整BMI后的合并HR：每SD log[PanAdipo]为1.31 [1.03–1.67]）和高脂血症（1.11 [1.04–1.18]）相关。结论：AI赋能的超声心动图提供了一种可扩展的数字生物标志物，可表征显著心外膜脂肪，并与不良心代谢特征相关，凸显超声心动图在代谢风险分层中的作用。

items.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.
items.summary_zh: ActiveMedAgent在多模态医疗诊断中学习按诊断效用减成本逐步获取信息的策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提示选择不获取哪些信息可能减少信息过载，但结果限于常用基准，不能替代真实临床决策评估。
items.abstract_zh: 临床诊断本质上是序贯的：只有当额外证据预期能消除诊断不确定性时，临床医生才会从廉价检查升级到昂贵检查。我们提出ActiveMedAgent框架，将这种成本感知的序贯逻辑引入多模态医疗AI。给定一个冻结的、通过API访问的视觉语言模型，ActiveMedAgent跟踪候选诊断的概率分布，并按每一步诊断效用减去成本为每次信息获取打分。随后，在这些已打分的轨迹上离线训练一个轻量级MLP控制器，学习何时请求额外证据以及何时作出判断。在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习持续优于无引导获取和全模态基线。值得注意的是，我们发现了信息过载效应。在175个病例中，智能体使用更少通道得到正确诊断，而全模态基线失败，表明学习省略什么与学习获取什么同样重要。
items.author_line: Weiwei Ma, Xiaobing Yu, Peijie Qiu, Jin Yang, Zhaoqi An, Xuanzhao Dong, Xiaoqi Zhao, Xiaofeng Liu

items.title: GLARE: Genomic Language model for Automated Repetitive Element classification
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable classification of transposable elements (TEs) is important for genome annotation and evolutionary analysis, yet remains challenging: TE families differ widely across taxa, reference databases label them inconsistently, and many TEs are represented only by degraded copies. We introduce GLARE (Genomic Language model for Automated Repetitive Element classification), a TE classifier built by fine-tuning a genomic language model on harmonized PanTEon and Repbase reference data to predict TE superfamily across 32 superfamilies in 11 orders. Among the genomic language models compared, Nucleotide Transformer v3 provided the strongest representation. Built on this backbone, GLARE exceeded all nine classifiers in the PanTEon benchmark, reaching 0.966 weighted superfamily F1 on its 30-superfamily task. GLARE also showed stronger generalization to clades absent from training, consistently exceeding state-of-the-art classifiers on holdouts spanning three taxonomic ranks: the order Poales, the phylum Arthropoda, and the kingdom Fungi. Training on both PanTEon and Repbase reduced the performance drop seen when a single-source model was applied to the other database. Under simulated sequence decay, GLARE was the most robust classifier tested, and it performed best on independently curated degraded libraries. These findings show that genomic language models fine-tuned on harmonized multi-source references can classify TEs robustly under the taxonomic, database, and sequence-quality shifts that matter in practice. GLARE is available at https://code.jgi.doe.gov/NHaas/glare.
items.summary_zh: GLARE将基因组语言模型微调用于32个超家族、11个目中的转座元件自动分类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在跨分类群、跨数据库与序列降解压力测试中优于九种分类器，并公开提供代码。
items.abstract_zh: 可靠分类转座元件（TE）对于基因组注释和进化分析非常重要，但仍具挑战性：TE家族在分类群间差异很大，参考数据库的标注并不一致，且许多TE仅以退化拷贝存在。我们介绍GLARE（Genomic Language model for Automated Repetitive Element classification）：一个TE分类器，通过在经协调的PanTEon和Repbase参考数据上微调基因组语言模型，预测11个目中32个超家族的TE超家族。在所比较的基因组语言模型中，Nucleotide Transformer v3提供了最强表征。以这一骨干为基础，GLARE在PanTEon基准上超过全部九种分类器，在其30个超家族任务中达到0.966的加权超家族F1。GLARE在训练中未出现的类群上也显示出更强泛化能力，在跨三个分类阶元的留出集上持续优于最先进分类器：Poales目、Arthropoda门和Fungi界。在PanTEon和Repbase上联合训练，减少了单一来源模型应用到另一数据库时的性能下降。在模拟序列退化条件下，GLARE是受测分类器中最稳健者，并在独立人工整理的退化文库上表现最佳。这些发现表明，在经协调的多来源参考数据上微调的基因组语言模型，能够在实践中重要的分类、数据库和序列质量分布变化下稳健地分类TE。GLARE可在https://code.jgi.doe.gov/NHaas/glare获取。

items.title: Probing Genomic Foundation Models with Splice-Variant Perturbations
items.abstract_or_text: As benchmarks saturate, traditional validation methods fail to capture the probabilistic representations of genomic foundation models. This study probes self-supervised generalists (NTv3 650M, Evo2 40B, Genos 10B) alongside task-specific specialists (SpliceAI, AlphaGenome, Borzoi) using a mechanistically focused paradigm centered on expert-curated single-nucleotide substitutions within the splicing regions of the exon-rich OPA1 gene. Extending this analysis across the broader corpus of OPA1 mutations, variants of uncertain significance (VUS), and an independent 65-gene dataset of spliceogenic mutations demonstrates that generalists can match task-specific networks. Training data scale, genetic diversity, and evolutionary context are key for capturing RNA splicing syntax, whereas sparse routing may constrain performance. Mechanistically, foundation models exhibit a compute-asymmetry: the Evo2 40B model frontloads compute into massive parameter scale to resolve single-nucleotide variants within a narrow 425-bp context window, whereas the bidirectional NTv3 650M model and the Genos 10B mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture backload compute to inference, requiring spatial logit aggregation and expansive context windows of up to 94 kb. Furthermore, classification accuracy across these foundation models benefitted from locus-specific thresholding rather than mutation-class calibration, exposing representation boundaries of the models.
items.summary_zh: 以OPA1剪接区单核苷酸变异为机制探针，研究比较了通用和专用基因组基础模型的表征边界。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了超越饱和基准的机制导向评估，显示模型规模、上下文和位点特异阈值会显著影响结果。
items.abstract_zh: 随着基准趋于饱和，传统验证方法无法捕捉基因组基础模型的概率表征。本研究采用以机制为中心的范式，围绕富含外显子的OPA1基因剪接区域内经专家整理的单核苷酸替换，对自监督通用模型（NTv3 650M、Evo2 40B、Genos 10B）和任务特异专家模型（SpliceAI、AlphaGenome、Borzoi）进行探测。将该分析扩展至更广泛的OPA1突变语料、意义未明变异（VUS）以及包含65个基因的独立致剪接突变数据集，表明通用模型可以匹配任务特异网络。训练数据规模、遗传多样性和进化背景是捕捉RNA剪接语法的关键，而稀疏路由可能限制性能。从机制上看，基础模型表现出计算不对称性：Evo2 40B模型将计算前置到巨大的参数规模中，从而在狭窄的425-bp上下文窗口内解析单核苷酸变异；而双向NTv3 650M模型和Genos 10B混合专家（MoE）架构则将计算后置于推理阶段，需要空间logit聚合和最高94 kb的宽广上下文窗口。此外，这些基础模型的分类准确率受益于位点特异阈值设定，而非突变类别校准，这暴露了模型的表征边界。
items.author_line: Alavi, M. V.

items.title: Precision Evidence Bench: Assessing PICO alignment and faithful reporting in clinical AI
items.abstract_or_text: Clinicians routinely make decisions for patients whose comorbidities, prior therapies, laboratory abnormalities, or demographic characteristics are not reflected in the supporting evidence, even though these factors can influence treatment selection. Given this gap in the evidence base, we sought to evaluate how AI models respond to clinical questions in which patient characteristics or the treatment comparison and outcome of interest may affect the applicability of available evidence. We developed and publicly released Precision Evidence Bench, a benchmark of 209 synthetic clinical questions with specified population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) elements. Each answer is assessed using a five item rubric that evaluates whether a single cited source matches the PICO and whether the answer faithfully reports its sources. The item verdicts determine one of five ratings, ranging from Precision match to Unsupported claim, without requiring a reference answer. We evaluated four frontier large language models (LLMs) using web search across all 209 questions, then repeated the evaluation with additional access to a corpus of precision evidence-based findings (pEBFs) designed to address these evidence gaps, using two corpus sizes. For every model, Precision match rates increased with the amount of precision evidence available, from 13 to 18% with web search alone to 17 to 28% with 100 million pEBFs and 41 to 56% with 500 million pEBFs. These findings suggest that access to matching evidence is an important determinant of LLM performance on precision medicine questions.
items.summary_zh: Precision Evidence Bench以209个合成PICO问题评估临床LLM的证据匹配与忠实报告。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准表明扩充精准证据语料可提高匹配率，直接量化了临床问答中“有证据”与“证据适用于该患者”的差别。
items.abstract_zh: 临床医生常需为合并症、既往治疗、实验室异常或人口学特征未被支持性证据反映的患者作出决策，尽管这些因素可能影响治疗选择。鉴于证据基础中的这一缺口，我们试图评估AI模型如何回答这类临床问题：其中患者特征，或所关注的治疗比较和结局，可能影响现有证据的适用性。我们开发并公开发布Precision Evidence Bench：一个包含209个合成临床问题的基准，每个问题都指定人群、干预、对照和结局（PICO）要素。每个回答使用一个五项量表评估：单一引用来源是否与PICO匹配，以及回答是否忠实报告其来源。条目判定决定从“精准匹配”到“无支持主张”的五种评级之一，且不需要参考答案。我们使用网络检索，在全部209个问题上评估四个前沿大语言模型（LLM）；随后又在额外访问旨在解决这些证据缺口的精准循证发现语料库（pEBF）条件下重复评估，并使用两种语料规模。对每一个模型，精准匹配率均随可获得精准证据量增加而提高：仅使用网络检索时为13%至18%，使用1亿条pEBF时为17%至28%，使用5亿条pEBF时为41%至56%。这些发现提示，获得匹配证据是决定LLM在精准医学问题上表现的重要因素。
items.author_line: Mukerji, A., Sanghavi, N., Lauritzen, T., Muralidharan, J., Gombar, S.

items.title: STEER-seq: a recombinase based platform for pooled multimodal single-cell perturbation screening
items.abstract_or_text: Pooled gain-of-function screening is a powerful method for screening for transcription factors whose overexpression leads to changes in cellular identity. However, variable transgene copy number, integration site and genomic context from random viral integration can confound quantitative comparisons between perturbations. We present STEER-seq (Single-cell Transgene Expression via Exchange Recombination sequencing), a virus-free platform for pooled ORF gain-of-function screening in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs). STEER-seq combines irreversible Bxb1-mediated integration at a defined genomic safe-harbour locus with promoterless donor libraries and barcode-enabled perturbation tracking, enabling single-copy expression from a common promoter and genomic context and direct recovery of perturbation identity by single-cell sequencing. In a focused haematopoietic screen, SPI1 expression alone was sufficient to drive differentiation towards HSC/MPP-like progenitors in the absence of exogenous cytokines, with transient induction generating progenitors that retained multilineage haematopoietic differentiation potential. Joint RNA-chromatin accessibility profiling linked transcription factor-induced transcriptional responses to chromatin remodelling and enabled reconstruction of perturbation-induced gene regulatory networks, including a RUNX2-driven osteoblast programme. Scaling STEER-seq to around 2,000 human coding sequences enabled systematic discovery of transcription factors capable of inducing distinct cell-state programmes, including neural progenitor-, melanocyte- and vascular smooth muscle-like states, as well as maintenance of pluripotency. STEER-seq provides a scalable, quantitative framework for single-cell and multimodal gain-of-function screening, enabling functional discovery and engineering of human cell identity.
items.summary_zh: STEER-seq以重组酶定点单拷贝整合和单细胞多模态读出，实现人iPSC池化获得功能筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 约2,000个人类编码序列的规模以及RNA-染色质联合测量，使其成为功能性细胞状态工程的通用实验平台。
items.abstract_zh: 池化获得功能筛选是筛选如下转录因子的有力方法：其过表达会导致细胞身份改变。然而，随机病毒整合造成的转基因拷贝数、整合位点和基因组背景变化，可能混杂不同扰动之间的定量比较。我们提出STEER-seq（Single-cell Transgene Expression via Exchange Recombination sequencing），这是一个在人体诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）中进行池化ORF获得功能筛选的无病毒平台。STEER-seq将Bxb1介导的不可逆整合于确定的基因组安全港位点，与无启动子供体文库和条形码支持的扰动追踪相结合，使单拷贝表达来自共同启动子和基因组背景，并可通过单细胞测序直接恢复扰动身份。在一个聚焦的造血筛选中，单独表达SPI1即足以在无外源细胞因子的条件下推动向HSC/MPP样祖细胞分化；短暂诱导产生的祖细胞保留多谱系造血分化潜能。联合RNA-染色质可及性分析将转录因子诱导的转录反应与染色质重塑相联系，并可重建扰动诱导的基因调控网络，包括一个由RUNX2驱动的成骨细胞程序。将STEER-seq扩展至约2,000个人类编码序列后，系统发现了可诱导不同细胞状态程序的转录因子，包括神经祖细胞样、黑色素细胞样和血管平滑肌样状态，以及维持多能性。STEER-seq提供了一个可扩展、定量的单细胞和多模态获得功能筛选框架，可用于人类细胞身份的功能发现和工程化。

items.title: Prospective validation of an uncertainty-aware machine learning model for secondary progressive multiple sclerosis classification
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) often progresses to secondary-progressive MS (SPMS), but diagnosis is typically retrospective, delaying potential interventions. Existing rule-based and machine learning approaches often lack prospective validation and provide no uncertainty estimates, limiting clinical adoption. Objective: To prospectively evaluate a conformal prediction (CP)-enabled random forest model for reproducing clinician-recorded disease course labels in the Swedish Multiple Sclerosis Registry (SMSReg) and compare its classifications with the Lorscheider criteria. Methods: The CP model was trained and calibrated on SMSReg-2022 (10,787 individuals, 85,461 hospital visits) and then validated on SMSReg-2025 (15,719 individuals, 45,077 hospital visits; not included in the SMSReg-2022 training/calibration/testing datasets). Performance was assessed at the hospital visit and individual levels and compared with the Lorscheider criteria. Results: The model maintained good calibration on the prospective dataset. At the per-hospital visit-level, the model accuracies were 92% (RRMS) and 95% (SPMS). At the individual level, sensitivity was 98%, specificity 89%, and F1-score 0.75. With clinician-recorded labels as reference, the model showed higher sensitivity than the Lorscheider criteria (98% vs. 71%), more transition assignments (90% vs. 57%), and higher F1-score (0.76 vs. 0.69). Conclusion: The CP-enabled model prospectively reproduced clinician-recorded disease course labels with calibrated uncertainty, supporting harmonization and decision support.
items.summary_zh: 带保形预测的随机森林在瑞典多发性硬化登记队列中前瞻性复现临床疾病病程标签。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究使用独立的前瞻性时间切分进行验证并输出不确定性，支持登记数据协调和决策支持研究，尚不等于改变诊疗标准。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：复发缓解型多发性硬化（RRMS）常进展为继发进展型MS（SPMS），但诊断通常具有回顾性，从而延迟潜在干预。现有基于规则和机器学习的方法通常缺乏前瞻性验证，也不提供不确定性估计，限制了临床采用。目的：在Swedish Multiple Sclerosis Registry（SMSReg）中，前瞻性评估一个启用保形预测（CP）的随机森林模型复现临床医生记录的疾病病程标签的能力，并将其分类结果与Lorscheider标准比较。方法：该CP模型在SMSReg-2022（10,787名个体、85,461次医院就诊）上训练和校准，随后在SMSReg-2025（15,719名个体、45,077次医院就诊；未纳入SMSReg-2022训练、校准或测试数据集）上验证。于医院就诊和个体两个层面评估性能，并与Lorscheider标准比较。结果：该模型在前瞻性数据集上维持良好校准。在每次医院就诊层面，模型对RRMS和SPMS的准确率分别为92%和95%。在个体层面，敏感度为98%，特异度为89%，F1分数为0.75。以临床医生记录的标签为参照时，该模型的敏感度高于Lorscheider标准（98%对71%），给出的转换判定更多（90%对57%），F1分数也更高（0.76对0.69）。结论：启用CP的模型以经校准的不确定性前瞻性复现了临床医生记录的疾病病程标签，支持开展协调化和决策支持。
items.author_line: Parakkal Sreenivasan, A., Noui, Y., Erngren, I., Spjuth, O., Burman, J., Kultima, K.

items.title: Generative inverse design steers human hematopoietic cell fate in vitro
items.abstract_or_text: Inverse design has advanced the discovery of molecules and materials. Yet it remains largely unexplored for steering cell fate, where inputs are continuous, combinatorial culture conditions and outputs are distributions of cell states. Human hematopoiesis, in which combinations and doses of growth factors steer stem cells toward each blood lineage, is a demanding test case. While forward models can evaluate discrete conditions, the vast combinatorial space renders searching for a specific, target-producing design an intractable inverse problem. Here, we introduce LabCompass, an inverse-modeling framework that optimizes experimental designs toward candidates expected to produce specified target cell states, using a flow-matching generative model guided by cellular phenotypes predicted by a forward surrogate. We applied LabCompass to primary human CD34+ in vitro cultures, where continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters govern hematopoietic cell fate. In a lab-in-the-loop setting, we experimentally validated model-driven designs and used these measurements to update the model across four successive loops. LabCompass recovered established lineage-inducing designs, improved predictions with new data, and enriched target populations across lineages. Incorporating new parameters expanded the design space and enriched rare populations beyond initial reach. Across loops, we generated a 78-million-cell spectral flow cytometry dataset and identified distinct culture conditions converging on the same target cell states. Our results establish generative inverse modeling as a compelling paradigm for navigating high-dimensional, continuous experimental spaces, and demonstrate that virtual cell models should be judged not only by how accurately they predict cellular responses, but also by how effectively they guide experiments toward desired biological outcomes.
items.summary_zh: LabCompass以流匹配生成模型和实验闭环优化人CD34+细胞培养条件，定向富集目标细胞状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 四轮实验闭环和7,800万细胞流式数据集表明，生成式逆向设计可实际指导细胞命运实验，而非仅做前向预测。
items.abstract_zh: 逆向设计推动了分子和材料发现，但其在引导细胞命运方面仍基本未被探索；在这里，输入是连续、组合的培养条件，输出是细胞状态分布。人类造血是一个要求很高的测试案例，其中生长因子的组合和剂量将干细胞引向每一种血系。尽管前向模型可以评估离散条件，巨大的组合空间使寻找能产生特定目标的设计成为难以处理的逆问题。在此，我们介绍LabCompass：一个逆向建模框架，它使用由前向代理模型预测的细胞表型引导的流匹配生成模型，朝向预期产生指定目标细胞状态的候选实验设计进行优化。我们将LabCompass应用于原代人CD34+体外培养，其中连续的细胞因子和小分子参数控制造血细胞命运。在实验室闭环环境中，我们对模型驱动的设计进行了实验验证，并用这些测量在连续四轮循环中更新模型。LabCompass重现了已建立的谱系诱导设计，利用新数据改进预测，并在不同谱系中富集目标群体。纳入新参数扩展了设计空间，并富集了最初无法触及的稀有群体。跨各轮循环，我们生成了一个包含7,800万个细胞的光谱流式细胞术数据集，并识别出收敛至相同目标细胞状态的不同培养条件。我们的结果将生成式逆向建模确立为在高维、连续实验空间中导航的一种有说服力的范式，并表明虚拟细胞模型的评判不应仅看其预测细胞反应的准确性，也应看其将实验引向期望生物学结果的有效性。
items.author_line: Paulas-Condori, L., Palma, A., Consoli, L., Rubio-Lara, J. A., Hidajat, O., Zheng, W., Klein, D., Martinuzzi, D. G., Wu, Z., Dittadi, A., Wilson, N. K., Gottgens, B., Theis, F. J.

items.title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
items.summary_zh: RACE 用移除额外推理后参考动作的似然下降估计跨轮动作支撑，并据此训练智能体在推理与直接行动之间自适应选择。论文报告其在四类智能体基准上降低推理成本，同时维持或提升任务表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把“是否还需要继续推理”转化为可由行为似然计算的训练信号，并在多个代理基准上检验效率与任务表现；但摘要未提供各基准的具体数值，能力增益仍应以论文完整实验为准。
items.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已在复杂任务上展现出较强能力。它们通常会在交互轨迹中的每个动作之前进行推理。然而，并非每一轮都需要推理，因为较早产生的推理可以继续支持后续动作。因此，关键挑战是在不依赖成本高昂的生成式验证的情况下，确定既有推理何时仍然足够、何时需要新的推理步骤。我们发现，在移除额外推理后，后续参考动作的似然下降与这些动作在给定较早推理时是否仍可恢复密切对应，为估计跨轮动作支撑提供了有效且轻量的信号。基于这一观察，我们提出 Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation（RACE），一种用于自适应智能体推理的训练方法。RACE 引入 Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection（LoGiC）过程，逐步识别那些被移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次。由此得到的移除信号被同时纳入监督微调和智能体强化学习，使策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动。在四个具有代表性的智能体基准上的大量实验表明，RACE 在维持或提升任务表现的同时，显著降低了推理成本。
items.author_line: Yiruo Cheng, Shen Huang, Xiaoshuai Song, Jiejun Tan, Guanting Dong, Pengjun Xie, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou

items.title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
items.abstract_or_text: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.
items.summary_zh: Cluster-TNN 在每个小批次中局部进行图提升，以避免拓扑深度学习的全图高阶结构物化。论文在 21 组与全图执行相匹配的比较中报告所有配置的峰值 GPU 内存均下降，平均降幅为 83.2%，且预测性能保持有竞争力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法针对高阶图、超图和单纯复形上的学习提出可检验的扩展策略，并以匹配的全图比较和内存指标报告结果；摘要中的性能表述为“有竞争力”，不应解读为在所有任务上优于全图训练。
items.abstract_zh: Topological Deep Learning 将基于图的学习扩展到高阶域，例如超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形。这些域通常通过图提升过程从输入图中的模式构造而来。全域训练会在模型执行前构建并存储完整的提升表示。在 Reddit（23.3 万个节点和 5730 万条边）等大型稠密数据集上，这种全局物化会成为严重的计算瓶颈，往往使训练无法进行。为解决这一限制，我们引入 Cluster-TNN，这是一种通过局部提升来避免该瓶颈的领域无关框架。在预处理阶段对输入图进行划分后，Cluster-TNN 在运行时动态采样节点簇组，重建其诱导子图以形成小批次，并在每个小批次内应用选定的提升操作。保留采样节点之间的所有边，可维持构造跨簇高阶结构所需的连通性，从而产生现有 Topological Neural Networks 能够直接处理的拓扑小批次。在与全图执行进行的 21 组匹配比较中，Cluster-TNN 在每种配置下都降低了峰值 GPU 内存，平均降低 83.2%，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。值得注意的是，据我们所知，这一降幅首次使多种不同的高阶 Topological Neural Networks 能够在 Reddit 和 OGBN Products 等大型数据集上训练。这些结果确立了 Cluster-TNN 作为一种通用策略，可将 Topological Deep Learning 扩展到超越全局域构建限制的规模。
items.author_line: David Leko, Luka Benić, Guillermo Bernárdez, Nina Miolane, Olga Fink, Lev Telyatnikov

items.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning? Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose Evolving Functional REpertoires (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.
items.summary_zh: EFRE 将单一优化提示替换为会随新任务到来而演化的功能集合：兼容更新改进已有函数，冲突更新产生新函数。摘要报告，在三任务持续学习流中其最终平均表现比 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点，且适应 Bio 任务后 FinQA 的表现降幅为 1.56 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接检验提示优化在持续学习中的遗忘问题，并给出与 GRPO 和基础提示优化的量化对照；其证据目前限于三任务流及所述骨干模型，不能据此泛化为对所有持续学习或数学推理任务的结论。
items.abstract_zh: 持续学习对于大语言模型仍然具有挑战性：模型必须在不降低既有能力的情况下获得新技能和知识。现有方法通常通过精心设计模型参数的更新方式来应对这一挑战。相比之下，提示优化避免了成本高昂的参数更新，同时在单个知识密集型和推理任务上取得了可与 GRPO 等强化学习方法相当、甚至更优的性能。这提出了一个自然问题：作为一种高效的适应方法，提示优化能否直接应用于持续学习？我们的分析表明，在顺序任务适应下，它会遭受灾难性遗忘，而优化后的提示会累积规则并对局部任务分布过拟合。为解决这些局限，我们提出 Evolving Functional REpertoires（EFRE），它以会随着新任务到来而演化的函数集合取代单一提示：兼容的更新会改进既有函数，而冲突的更新会触发新函数的产生。在一个三任务持续学习流上，EFRE 的最终平均性能比 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点。此外，在适应 Bio 任务后，它在 FinQA 上的性能仅下降 1.56 个百分点，而基础提示优化方法下降 25.10 个百分点。我们还在一个极简智能体系统中实例化 EFRE，并观察到其在不同骨干模型上持续改进。总体而言，这些结果表明 EFRE 在大语言模型持续学习中表现强劲，并凸显了其在高级智能体系统持续学习中的巨大潜力。
items.author_line: Fengyuan Liu, Yue Wang, Hangxi Guo, Fengyuan Liu, Chenxu Wu, Yanguang Liu, Mengnan Du

items.title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.
items.summary_zh: RiCo 以稀疏的接触表面点邻域表示刚体间相互作用，并在物体内传播接触信息以预测运动。在 MOVi-benchmark 上，论文报告相较基线将 100 帧位置误差降低 31%–35%、姿态误差降低约 38%，并在最多 270 个物体的场景中进行零样本泛化测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 刚体接触推理有明确的局部几何与物理约束，论文采用长时轨迹误差、接触保真度和规模泛化进行检验；其真实多球碰撞结果仅构成初步的仿真到现实迁移证据。
items.abstract_zh: 对刚体相互作用进行准确模拟对于预测性物理世界模型至关重要。尽管近期在建模物体动力学方面取得了进展，但捕捉表面之间的局部接触如何塑造物体运动仍具挑战。端到端世界模型虽然预测整个场景或物体的相互作用，但在实践中，刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近表面能够直接交换接触力。受此观察启发，我们引入 Rigid-body Contact Reasoning（RiCo），它通过接触表面点的稀疏邻域来表示物体之间的相互作用。RiCo 将每个点的状态与附近表面的相对几何、运动和物理属性结合，然后在物体的各点之间进行推理，以确定这些局部接触如何共同影响其运动。通过将跨物体推理限制在邻近表面，同时在每个刚体内部传播接触信息，RiCo 在无需建模场景中每一对点的代价下保留细粒度交互细节。这些特性使 RiCo 具有更高的准确性和接触保真度。在 MOVi-benchmark 上的实验表明，与基线相比，RiCo 将 100 帧位置误差和姿态误差分别降低 31%–35% 和约 38%。此外，RiCo 实现了较高的接触保真度：相对于真实值的穿透时间差和平均深度差分别为 11.0% 和 2.22 mm。RiCo 还可从小规模训练场景零样本泛化到包含 270 个物体的场景。我们的真实多球碰撞实验进一步为仿真到现实的迁移提供了初步证据。

items.title: Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.
items.summary_zh: 该工作针对形态神经网络的稀疏权重雅可比与较弱梯度问题，提出受 Multiplicative Weights Update（MWU）启发的相关性权重更新。它在九个基准上评测独立全连接层和更大 Transformer 中的层，报告八个基准改进，最高为 32.84 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将形态感知器的更新明确地联系到专家建议学习，并通过跨九个基准的比较与运行间方差检验其经验效果；摘要没有给出各基准、模型或统计显著性细节，因此改进范围仍需结合完整实验解读。
items.abstract_zh: 神经网络通常使用一阶方法和反向传播进行训练。对于形态层而言，这种方法是否最优尚不明确，因为其权重雅可比矩阵稀疏，得到的参数梯度可能较差。在这项工作中，我们提出一种受 Multiplicative Weights Update（MWU）方案启发、用于形态神经网络的新型权重更新方法。我们将每个形态感知器视为对数空间中“从专家建议中学习”问题的一个实例，并使用一种基于相关性的奖励：无论强梯度信号是否已到达其权重，只要输入与期望的输出变化一致，该奖励就偏向这些输入。我们通过训练全连接层来实证评估该方法，既将其作为独立模型，也将其作为更大 Transformer 网络的一部分。在九个基准上，相关性训练在其中八个基准上带来改进，最高达 32.84 个百分点，同时显著降低了不同运行之间的变异性。

items.abstract_or_text: Dusting off this tweet from April because this gap in shared understanding of LLM capability is *widening*. It's now less "two groups of people speaking past each other" and more a sharp funnel. - Napkin math somewhere around 6B people (~75% of the population) have barely come in contact with LLMs at all. - Around 1-2B (~20%) are casual and infrequent users of free-tier ChatGPT-like products. - Now we get to professional use of frontier-grade LLMs in math&code. Somewhere around 20M people (0.2%) see first-hand that large, complex projects that used to take them weeks/months can now be completed by agents with a prompt. - And finally we get to the ~5,000 people (~0.00006%) with access to frontier-grade systems internally. The funnel is driven by ambition, jaggedness of capability, and access.

items.abstract_zh: 把四月的这条帖文翻出来，因为人们对 LLM 能力的共同理解之间的差距正在扩大。现在已经不太像“两个群体各说各话”，而更像一个陡峭的漏斗。——粗略估算，约 60 亿人（约占人口 75%）几乎还没接触过 LLM。——约 10 亿至 20 亿人（约 20%）是 ChatGPT 类免费产品的偶尔、低频用户。——再往下是前沿级 LLM 在数学和代码中的专业使用者。大约 2,000 万人（0.2%）亲眼看到：过去需数周或数月的大型复杂项目，如今智能体凭一条提示就能完成。——最后是约 5,000 名（0.00006%）可在内部接触前沿系统的人。这个漏斗由雄心、能力的不平滑性和访问权限共同驱动。

items.abstract_or_text: A generalisation theory that applies to self-supervised learning scenarios: 1. Unlabeled samples cost X per sample 2. Labeled samples for a given task cost Y per sample. - assume X is zero, what can you say about the regret curve for the task, i.e. the area under the curve of task error vs number of labeled samples. - assume you want to be good at K tasks, what is the optimal number of unlabeled samples n and labelled samples per task m that minimize the cost (nX+mKY) to reach a given error rate on all tasks.
items.summary_zh: Yann LeCun 提出一个关于自监督学习泛化的成本问题：在无标注与标注样本成本不同、且需服务多个任务时，如何最小化达到给定误差率的总成本。帖文提出问题，未提供推导或答案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以清晰的成本—样本量设定，把自监督预训练的价值与多任务标注分配连接起来，具备进一步理论讨论的具体抓手。
items.abstract_zh: 一种适用于自监督学习场景的泛化理论：1. 无标注样本每个成本 X；2. 给定任务的标注样本每个成本 Y。——假设 X 为零，你能对该任务的遗憾曲线（即任务误差相对于标注样本数量的曲线下面积）说什么？——假设你希望在 K 个任务上表现良好，达到所有任务给定误差率时，使成本（nX+mKY）最小化的无标注样本最优数 n 和每个任务的标注样本最优数 m 是多少？
